entities.name: PMID:25091988
observations: Primary study titled “Sunitinib mesylate inhibits proliferation of human colonic stromal fibroblasts in vitro and in vivo.”
Reports inhibited growth of primary human colonic fibroblasts in vitro; low-dose sunitinib blocked PDGF-BB-induced proliferation and PDGFR-β signaling.

In nude mice, sunitinib reduced growth of tumors formed by co-injected SW620 colorectal cancer cells and colonic fibroblasts; this is a composite tumor-growth endpoint, not direct fibroblast-specific proliferation measurement.
